description: A controlled RouterOS configuration designed to pass the implemented security checks.
A controlled RouterOS configuration containing exposed services, duplicate addressing, and a broad firewall rule.
A DHCP and addressing scenario with reserved addresses, duplicated networks, overlapping pools, and missing firewall baselines.
A static routing scenario with invalid destinations, missing gateways, recursive resolution failures, duplicates, and unsafe gateway values.
A firewall ordering and exposure scenario covering unreachable rules, shadowing, duplicates, invalid matchers, and exposed management ports.
A destination NAT scenario with duplicate masquerade, broad exposure, invalid translations, conflicting forwards, and missing protection.
A service-hardening scenario with remote DNS exposure, Layer-2 management exposure, proxy services, SNMP, and bandwidth-test risks.
A dependency-integrity scenario with undefined interfaces, lists, bridge objects, DHCP references, firewall references, and NAT references.
A partial export containing exposed management services and incomplete firewall context.
A remediated baseline with restricted services, default drops, safe DHCP ranges, NAT masquerade, and a resolvable default route.
